title: Built my first mobile game using only Gemini ecosystem
author: moonbacostudio
selftext:
Built in couple of weeks using AI for everything, models, code, music, brainstorm, etc. 

Used basically Gemini 3.8 Flash with Unity MCP, blender MCP and meshy AI for models. 

Any feedbacks? I will release on iOS to see if I get anything from it!

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: Building a game with Gemini when gpt and Claude exist is a wild thing to do but looks nice despite

replies.author: kilographix
replies.body: Honestly looks less vibe coded than the stuff I've done in claude/gpt. It might be because claude always uses the same style for everything if you dont tell it what to do lol

replies.author: moonbacostudio
replies.body: I used Gemini because I had one year Google Pro subscription for free using a student promo, and honestly, Gemini Flash 3.8 is awesome, I can basically prompt all day it gets things done and never runs out of limit. It is harder to “one shot a game with one prompt” so you have to break into smaller tasks it does just fine!

replies.author: Blake9712
replies.body: A year of free Gemini pro is an acceptable reason

comments.author: MapApprehensive1867
comments.body: Impressive because it was made by gemini. Did you use antigravity?

replies.author: moonbacostudio
replies.body: Yes antigravity IDE with Unity mcp basically

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Looks good, especially surprised by gemini. Would love to see some more dynamic level design and other obstacles.

replies.author: moonbacostudio
replies.body: Yes! This is the 1st version trying to validate the idea, the plan is to put more dynamism! I would love to hear some ideas from you 😻💪🏻

replies.author: Maple-Syrup89
replies.body:
Well I loved the object throwing to distract. Cats always knock shit over, so more physics there would be fun. more things to knock over and call attention to. Dogs, other enemies that behave very differently and require different problem solving skills. The first half of the video is just kiting around. I would imagine a variety of sneak levels, "claws blazing" levels, object interaction, things like that. 

  
I might imagine a variety of lighting environments that help or hinder you. Dynamic hiding spots that give you cover until they blow up your spot and give you away. Some way to get enemies wrapped up might also be fun. Can different enemy types be foiled in a certain way? tangled in a power cord? knocked out by a falling object from a bookshelf? 

  
Its a fun theme, and the animations already look great. curious how you got th emodels and rigged them

replies.author: moonbacostudio
replies.body:
Thankss you gave some Nice ideas! The models were made using meshy AI. I used nano banana to generate a clean reference image and meshy did the modeling and texture for me. 

For the human meshy had some pre made running and walking animations so its was easy it did for me perfectly.

But quadrupeds its harder specially the running one. I found a free running dog rigged animation online download it and prompted Gemini to use it as a reference for the cat and it got 90% right using blender mcp, from there I just did some polishing myself

comments.author: takshit2
comments.body: Prompting a game using Gemini.. I would say this is pure skill. This looks way better and polished than Opus 5.5 games I've seen. Love it
